stories.summary: Russia and Ukraine implemented a 32-hour Easter ceasefire from April 11-12, but both sides accused each other of thousands of violations. Ukraine reported 469 ceasefire breaches by Russia, while Moscow claimed Ukrainian forces violated the truce nearly 2,000 times.
